mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the drainage network to the supplied arm was most worthwhile because it brought the supply and return processes together and showed their effect on tissue fluid.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the collecting route to the venous junction was clear but felt like a predictable intermediate step.

surprise.text: I learned that fluid entering lymphatic capillaries can carry proteins and is then called lymph.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; each connection had a visible purpose in completing the supply or return route.

continue.text: I would choose to continue for another chapter: seeing the completed fluid-return route connect back to the working arm made me curious about how another body system would fit into the model.
